name: CutCraft v1.1.0 (Auto-Updater & Startup Update Check Release)
releaseNotes:
CutCraft v1.1.0 Release Update:
- Robust auto-updater with SHA-256 checksum verification and secure HTTPS downloading
- Automatically check for updates on startup setting (Enabled / Disabled) in Settings menu
- Interactive startup notification with Download and Install, Remind Me Later, and Skip This Version
- Manual update check in Settings and Help menu displaying installed and latest version
- Full keyboard navigation and NVDA screen reader live announcements with readable progress updates
- Process-safe extraction and automatic restart after update
